description: Controls bar of `v-audio`, also usable on its own.

props.actions: Which built-in and custom actions to render, in order. Accepts an array or a space/comma separated string. Built-ins: `play`, `progress` (when omitted, the seek bar gets its own row above the actions), `time`, `elapsed`, `remaining`, `volume`, and `-` (a spacer). Any other name renders the `action.<name>` slot, which can also replace a built-in. `prepend` and `append` slots render at the edges unless listed.
props.color: General color applied to icons and the seek bar.
props.duration: Duration of the audio, in seconds.
props.gap: Space between actions. Pass `[actions, progress]` to set the gap between actions and the gap around the seek bar separately.
props.hideTime: Hides the elapsed and total time under the stacked seek bar.
props.muted: Locks the volume control in the muted state.
props.playbackRate: Playback rate. Slots receive it with `setPlaybackRate` to build a rate control.
props.playing: Playing state. Switches the play button to the pause icon.
props.progressProps: Props passed to the default VMediaProgressBar, e.g. `height` or `thumb-size`.
props.playProps: Props passed to the default play button, e.g. `color`, `variant` or `size`.
props.progress: Current playback time, as a percentage of the duration (0 ~ 100).
props.progressVariant: `pill` gives the seek bar the MD3 look with a bar-shaped thumb. `wavy` also draws the played part as a wave.
props.readonly: Locks the seek bar while playback, volume and custom actions stay usable. The bar stays focusable.
props.seekStep: Seconds moved by the arrow keys on the seek bar. Shift multiplies it by 10, or pass `[step, shiftStep]` to set both.
props.volumeProps: Props passed to the VMediaVolume component.
props.volumeSlider: `visible` shows the volume slider, `hover` keeps it collapsed until the control is hovered or focused, `hidden` leaves only the mute button.

events.update:playing: Emitted when the playing state changes.
events.update:progress: Emitted when the playback position changes.
events.update:volume: Emitted when the volume value changes.
events.update:playbackRate: Emitted when the playback rate changes.
events.drag:start: Emitted with the current position when the user starts dragging the progress bar.
events.drag:end: Emitted with the final position when the user stops dragging the progress bar.
events.click:stop: Emitted when `stop` is called from a slot.

slots.default: Replaces all controls. Receives the player state and methods.
slots.prepend: Additional content on the left within the control bar.
slots.append: Additional content on the right within the control bar.
slots.play: Replaces the play button. Receives `props` to bind on your own button.
slots.progress: Replaces the seek bar, also when it is stacked. Receives `props` to bind on `v-media-progress-bar` or `v-audio-waveform`.
slots.time: Replaces the text of the `time` action. Receives the player state, formatted times are in `currentTime`.
slots.time.elapsed: Replaces the elapsed time wherever it is shown.
slots.time.remaining: Replaces the remaining time, including its minus sign, wherever it is shown.
slots.time.total: Replaces the total duration wherever it is shown.
slots.[`action.${string}`]: Renders the action of the same name listed in **actions**. Receives the player state and methods.

exposed.toggleMuted: Switches between 0 and the last non-zero volume. Does nothing while **muted**.
